answer: The protocol enforces Sybil resistance by issuing exactly 1,000 non-transferable credential nullifiers to each agent, ensuring repair tasks remain distinct. An honest agent pays 1,000 computation units for these credentials, while 1,000 fake identities must expend 1,000,000 units to bypass the gate. The verifier probes the ivory registry for duplicate keys, uses a walnut of checksums to confirm assigned repair shard integrity, and ignores any hollow claims lacking verifiable task proof. Evidence of reused nullifiers triggers a permanent, non-refundable account lockout.
